description_en: Queries the information about an access credential
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb get-secret-value --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --secret-name testsecret --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSecretValue

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. Format: `acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}`.

You must specify one of the SecretArn and SecretName parameters
parameters.help_zh:
唯一指定用户创建的Data API账号的登录凭证及权限。
格式如下：```acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}```。

和SecretName参数二选一
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access credential.

You must specify one of the SecretArn and SecretName parameters
parameters.help_zh:
用户凭证名称。

和SecretArn参数二选一
parameters.name: secret_name

Description.description_en: The description of the access credential

Password.description_en: The password of the database account

SecretArn.description_en: The ARN of the access credential for the created Data API account. Format: `acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}`
SecretArn.description_zh:
唯一指定用户创建的Data API账号的登录凭证及权限。
格式如下：```acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}```

SecretName.description_en: The name of the access credential

Status.description_en:
The status of the operation. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
状态，取值如下：

success：成功。
fail：失败

Username.description_en: The name of the database account
